name: Barbell
status: in force since 2026-09-22 — rules-only paper index, no vault and no capital; inception anchored (see decisions.jsonl, 2026-09-22-barbell-paper-inception). The working-capital sleeve is a T-bill proxy (DTB3) until a fully-reserved fiat-backed stable exists on GIWA. Ticker qDUO decided by the owner on 2026-09-22 after the first mark: the genesis line (2026-09-22) carries the index label "Barbell", lines from 2026-09-23 carry "qDUO"; the series is identified by its file, not the label.

source.rulebook: quadrix/docs/methodology/barbell.md (site repo, private) — draft of 2026-09-21 with the owner's evening decisions D1/D2/D3/D5 applied
source.note: This file is the implemented parameter set; the prose rulebook is the narrative record of why. Where the two differ the prose rulebook governs and this file is wrong and should be fixed.

monetary.rule: fixed list, not a screen. BTC alone. A change to the list is a rule change (decision document, anchor, no retroactive effect).
monetary.note: ETH was not tested in this product and is not in it (barbell.md §1).

workingCapital.rule: fiat-backed stablecoins, fully reserved in cash and short Treasuries, issuer attestation published, canonical on the settlement chain. Interest-bearing forms ARE allowed (owner 2026-09-21, D3 = triens.md D10). Partially-reserved, synthetic and crypto-collateralised forms are not. Point-based yield instead of interest is not.
workingCapital.nameListStatus: open — the list itself is an anchored decision (D3-b) and cannot be written yet: no fiat-backed stablecoin is canonical on GIWA (미확인, barbell.md §12-2).

paperProxy.what: a synthetic $1 unit accruing the 3-month Treasury bill rate daily: unitValue *= (1 + r/100)^(1/365) per calendar day, r = FRED DTB3, last published print carried forward on days with no print
paperProxy.source: FRED DTB3 (3-Month Treasury Bill, Secondary Market Rate, Discount Basis, percent p.a.), https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=DTB3
paperProxy.why: the sleeve's real assets do not exist on chain yet, so the paper record cannot hold them. The backtest ran the sleeve at the T-bill rate (barbell_common.py cash_step, mode 'tbill'); the paper record uses the same assumption rather than a zero-yield dollar, and stamps `wcProxy: "DTB3"` on every record line so the level is never mistaken for a held asset.
paperProxy.notModelled: issuer spread (the issuer keeps part of the bill yield), redemption risk, depeg, and any on-chain yield that is not the bill. The real sleeve will differ by all of these.

depeg.rule: a held stablecoin quoted below $0.98 for 72 consecutive hours on two price sources is replaced at the next run by the next name on the decision list; if there is no replacement the position is held and the event is recorded in a decision document
depeg.status: draft threshold (barbell.md D4 / triens.md D17) — no measurement behind $0.98 or 72h
depeg.implementedNote: not implemented in the keeper: the paper record holds the DTB3 proxy, which has no peg to break. This block is carried so the parameter is written down before the sleeve holds a real name.

eligibility.note: no screen, no ranking, no weighting inside a sleeve: two assets at fixed weights (barbell.md §2~5). What the product does NOT hold is the only list: wrapped/bridged BTC, synthetic stablecoins, and stablecoins paying points instead of interest.

reconstitution.rule: first run after 00:00 UTC on Jan 1 / Apr 1 / Jul 1 / Oct 1 — the same day as qREV and qDEFI

tolerance.rule: if EVERY sleeve's drifted (mark-to-market) weight is within 5 percentage points of its target, no sleeve is traded at all; otherwise every sleeve is reset to target
tolerance.source: barbell.md §6 ("5%p 안이면 거래하지 않는다"), inherited from qREV §6 practice and not separately tested in this product (D8)
tolerance.divergenceFromBacktest: the P1 grid reset the ratio exactly at every quarter (barbell_common.py simulate_btc_cash, mode 'always'): it has no tolerance. The published multiples therefore come from a slightly higher-turnover rule than this one.

reconstitution.betweenReconstitutions: no trading. Interest accrued in the working-capital sleeve stays in that sleeve and is redistributed only at the quarterly reset — which is what the backtest did (weekly accrual, quarterly reset).

driftBand.note: no drift band (barbell.md §7). Quarterly-with-no-band beat monthly and beat ±5pp / ±10pp drift bands in all eight windows of the cadence comparison, at lower turnover. Do not re-propose.

conditionalSwitch.note: no 6:4 <-> 4:6 conditional switch (barbell.md §7, owner 2026-09-21). Thirteen trend / volatility / drawdown rules were tested over eight windows; none beat the fixed ratio consistently and all ran two to three times the turnover. A weekly on/off rule belongs to the tools line, not the index line.

btcPrice.primary: CoinGecko coins/markets (paginated to top 500) — the same snapshot keeper/paper-index.mjs marks qREV, qDEFI and the qX20 basket from
btcPrice.fallback: CoinPaprika tickers (price only), then the last known price for at most 3 consecutive runs (qX20 §9); after that the run fails rather than marking a stale book

workingCapitalRate.fallback: the most recent cached copy of the same series; no second source

stablecoinClassification.primary: DefiLlama stablecoins, pegMechanism = fiat-backed, plus the anchored name list
stablecoinClassification.note: not used by the paper record (the proxy has no name list)

specialEvents.note: migrations, hacks and delistings are out of scope for this implementation pass, as for qREV/qDEFI. BTC has no death trigger (barbell.md §9).

fees.decision: owner 2026-09-22 (barbell.md D6): 0.5% per year streaming, no performance fee, redemption fee permanently prohibited. The launch value is a permanent ceiling — the contract accepts reductions only.
fees.note: the paper level is GROSS, like qREV's and qDEFI's. Cost disclosure is a separate net-of-fee row in the research (net_multiple_05), not a second level in this record.

basket._doc: No basket vault exists for this index and none can be deployed while GIWA carries no canonical BTC (barbell.md §12-1, quadrix/docs/research/btc-representations.md). vault null = the keeper computes every mark and posts nothing.
